scorers.net: the network's expected cost over all 1024 candidates (p_reach * cost_hat + (1-p_reach) * 50)
scorers.true: the EXACT cost c(s,R,C); unreachable = +inf. The oracle for what this network is trained to predict.
scorers.b1: baseline B1, the any-stop relaxation distance
scorers.net+h: net plus the any-stop relaxation distance of the TARGET robot in the resulting state -- i.e. the f = g + c + h priority Stage 1's exhaustive A* used
scorers.true+h: true plus the any-stop relaxation distance of the TARGET robot in the resulting state -- i.e. the f = g + c + h priority Stage 1's exhaustive A* used
scorers.b1+h: b1 plus the any-stop relaxation distance of the TARGET robot in the resulting state -- i.e. the f = g + c + h priority Stage 1's exhaustive A* used

buckets.reach: ranked over only the candidates physics says are reachable (Stage 3's expansion knows this exactly)
